museum.blurb: The workstation Steve Jobs built after Apple threw him out, and the software that outlived the hardware: object-oriented Unix with a Display PostScript screen, whose NS-prefixed frameworks became Cocoa and are still what every Mac and iPhone app is written against. Tim Berners-Lee wrote the first web browser on one.
museum.notes: Live streamhost tile. Emulator-in-captured-Linux BRIDGE tile: a captured Debian 12 kiosk runs the Previous emulator (SVN r1847 = 4.4, built into the tile's own overlay together with SDL3) as a real NeXTcube — Motorola 68040 at 25 MHz, 64 MB, ROM Rev 2.5 v66 — booting NeXTSTEP 3.3 for m68k off a SCSI disk image; streamhost captures the Linux framebuffer + AC97 audio like every other bridge tile. The X root is made EXACTLY the 1120x832 of the NeXT MegaPixel display so the picture is pixel-exact and both cursors clamp at the same edges. This is deliberately NOT the Intel build of NeXTSTEP, which cannot survive a modern QEMU's SCSI/IDE timing — see docs/guests/nextstep.md. Pointer is ABSOLUTE: Previous emulates a SummaGraphics digitiser on the NeXT's serial port B, and NeXTSTEP's own tablet driver is attached inside the golden, so the coordinate a QEMU usb-tablet delivers is the pixel the NeXT arrow lands on; the guest draws that arrow itself. archetype mono-terminal; the ideal asset is a bespoke matte-black cube. See streamhost/docs/BRIDGE.md.

reset.fixture: NeXTSTEP 3.3 Workspace on an emulated NeXTcube: grey workspace, the Workspace menu at the top left, the File Viewer the machine opens for itself at login, and the Dock down the right-hand edge. Re-baked 2026-08-10 from a COLD boot under the final device set (-usb -device usb-tablet), after running /NextAdmin/InstallTablet.app once so the golden carries NeXTSTEP's own SummaGraphics tablet driver — a kernel server is the one thing a cold boot cannot carry, and `loadvm golden` is not a boot, so every visitor and every reset gets it. The desktop was pixel-diffed back onto the frame the install started from: 3209 px differ, all of them the temporary InstallTablet.app icon the install linked into /me and then removed, plus the cursor. Mouse is PASS, not UNVERIFIED: 24 of 24 commanded absolute targets — corners inset 8 px, edge midpoints, centre and 15 scattered points — landed at 0 px error on the LIVE tile after `loadvm golden` in a fresh QEMU process, and 8 QMP input-send-event absolute moves through the QEMU usb-tablet itself — the leg a browser actually drives — landed within 1 px, that 1 px being the probe's own 0..32767 quantisation. Keyboard stays UNVERIFIED: this is a GUI exhibit with no type-in demo. See docs/guests/nextstep.md.
